mentions.name: Ganttify
mentions.description: Gantt chart add-on for web applications and services that can benefit from a Gantt view. Its upcoming Google Calendar integration lets users fully manage their calendar in a Gantt chart, with customizations such as dependencies between events, custom colors for time blocks, and custom icons for single-day 'milestone'-like events; new integrations are planned to be released about once a month.
mentions.source_excerpt: Ganttify is a Gantt chart add-on for web applications or services that can benefit from a Gantt view.

mentions.name: Ganttify
mentions.description: Gantt chart add-on that turns tools like Todoist, Basecamp and Trello into an editable timeline with syncing capabilities and dependencies. Integrations are being consolidated into a single account, so users connect one or more integrations instead of separate per-tool products.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building Ganttify for a while now https://gantt-chart.com

The goals is to become THE Gantt chart add-on for anything. Currently works with Todoist, Basecamp and Trello. I’m struggling to find more markets.

It’s basically “Turn X into an editable timeline with syncing capabilities and dependencies”
